evidence: Static review; no runtime evidence is needed for this row. (1) Skill grep from quality-checks.md:26, widened with likert|verifier|oracle|grader|graded|checker|test\.sh|scoring|harbor|gate|CHANGE_ME|TODO|TBD, run case-insensitively over task/instruction.md, all six task/environment/instructions/*.md, environment/assets/seed_data.json and environment/Dockerfile: zero matches. (2) task/instruction.md:1-5 is a plain first-person product ask; the only paths named are /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json and /app, which are agent-visible deliverable/input paths, not test paths. The template placeholder 'CHANGE_ME' (template instruction.md:1) is replaced. (3) A second grep for evaluat|review|tested|assess|probe|grad|points|harness|MCP|helper matched only product language, e.g. security.md:5 'Refuse dynamic evaluation through eval, Function...', behaviour.md:9 'survive a complete server restart', integration.md:7 'shared between independent browser contexts', ui.md:17 'history inspection'. None names the judge, its tools or how the app is scored. (4) None of the 52 id/name values parsed from tests/*/*/judge.toml appears in the public files; the only sentinel-style token in the judge files, APP_RESTART_HELPER, is absent from the public files. (5) Word-level n-gram comparison of public text against all judge.toml, prompt.md and app_context.md text: zero shared 8-grams or longer; one shared 7-gram ('the preview, the console and the library'), which is ordinary product wording, not long verbatim overlap. (6) Agent image Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/; no tests or solution content. Adversarial reading: a builder cannot learn dimension names, weights, criterion ids, the restart helper or any probe value from the public material, and a conforming alternative is not penalised by this row. Limits: the private check-instruction-hygiene.py / check-instruction-content.py executables were not run; this is the manual application of their documented behaviour, not a portal checker result.
